name: Identity data
description: Data that directly identifies an individual, such as name or customer ID.

name: Contact data
description: Data used to contact or locate an individual.

name: Transaction data
description: Purchase and payment-adjacent order data excluding full payment card data.

name: Support interaction data
description: Case notes, ticket attachments, and communication history.

name: Marketing preference data
description: Consent signals, unsubscribe state, and campaign preferences.
